about.title: Bridging Civic Vigilance, Eco-Consciousness, and Plant Care with AI
about.desc: Traditional urban management often separates environmental consciousness from local community action. EcoCity Hub bridges this critical divide by uniting three essential pillars into a unified, intelligent web application.
about.pillar1Desc: Empowering individuals to measure exact emissions from transport, electricity, and diet using verifiable factors—accompanied by Gemini AI decarbonization plans.
about.pillar2Desc: Transforming smartphones into municipal observation eyes. Snap street hazards, let vision AI categorize problems, estimate danger, and draft ready-to-file complaints.
about.pillar3Desc: Nurturing greenery that purifies city air. Vision-capable Gemini detects plant diseases, identifies root causes, and recommends safe, organic home remedies.

features.title: Explore Our Three Core Features
features.subtitle: Three intelligent modules meticulously engineered to solve real-world urban and environmental challenges.
features.feat1Subtitle: Understand how your daily lifestyle affects the environment.
features.feat1P1: Transportation tracking across personal cars, motorcycles, buses, metro, and walking.
features.feat1P2: Monthly electricity consumption analytics in kWh.
features.feat1P4: Deterministic emission calculations with documented IPCC factors.
features.feat2Subtitle: Help make your neighbourhood cleaner and safer.
features.feat2P1: Upload photographs or videos of potholes, garbage, broken streetlights, and leaks.
features.feat2P2: Gemini Vision AI image recognition and automatic categorization.
features.feat2P4: Drafts official, ready-to-send municipal complaint letters.
features.feat2P5: Interactive Leaflet map pinpointing and lifecycle tracking (Draft to Resolved).
features.feat3Subtitle: Give your plants better care using AI.
features.feat3P1: Upload leaf and plant photographs or videos for immediate AI vision analysis.
features.feat3P2: Botanical plant identification with common and Latin scientific names.
features.feat3P3: Detection of chlorosis, necrosis, leaf spots, and pest infestations.
features.feat3P4: Safe, chemical-free organic treatments and home remedies.
features.feat3P5: Long-term prevention tips and complete plant care history.

homeScore.title: The Transparent Green Score System
homeScore.desc: Every action counts. Your Green Score is computed directly from recorded activities across three transparent pillars: 40% Carbon Footprint Reduction, 30% Civic Participation, and 30% Plant Care Stewardship.
homeScore.cardTitle: How Citizens Earn Genuine Green Score Points
homeScore.pillar1Desc: Earn points by conducting verifiable carbon audits and documenting reductions in your monthly commute and electricity usage.
homeScore.pillar2Desc: Earn +50 points for every street hazard reported, plus +25 bonus points when the issue is resolved by municipal authorities.
homeScore.pillar3Desc: Earn +30 points for diagnosing plant diseases with AI vision, adopting organic treatments, and nursing plants back to health.

howItWorks.title: How EcoCity Hub Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Turn daily urban observations into quantifiable environmental change in four simple steps.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Sign up in seconds, configure your city and preferred language, and access your private dashboard.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Calculate your travel and energy emissions, photograph or record street hazards, or diagnose an ailing houseplant.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Follow Gemini's decarbonization plan, dispatch civic complaints, and apply organic neem remedies.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Climb tiers from Green Beginner to Planet Protector, unlock prestigious badges, and inspire your community.

whyChoose.title: Why Choose EcoCity Hub?
whyChoose.subtitle: A purposeful blend of artificial intelligence, municipal engagement, and verifiable impact.
whyChoose.point1Desc: Vision-capable Gemini models provide instant analysis for photos and personalized lifestyle coaching.
whyChoose.point2Desc: Documented emission factors demystify how daily transportation and household power affect the climate.
whyChoose.point3Desc: Empowers residents to report potholes, water leaks, and illegal dumping directly to municipal departments.
whyChoose.point4Desc: Maintains urban and home flora with timely symptom recognition and chemical-free remedies.
whyChoose.point5Desc: Fosters neighborhood solidarity through public hazard reporting and collaborative city cleanup.
whyChoose.point6Desc: Transparent points computed directly from verified actions, not arbitrary frontend placeholders.

cta.title: Small Actions. Meaningful Change.
cta.desc: Your city becomes better when everyone contributes. Start your journey towards a greener tomorrow with EcoCity Hub.

footer.desc: One Platform. Three Problems. One Greener City. Empowering citizens to monitor their carbon impact, clean urban streets, and heal plants with AI.
footer.civicBoxDesc: Direct citizen reporting bridges the gap between urban municipal councils and daily environmental stewardship.

challenges.title: Weekly Green Challenges
challenges.subtitle: Complete eco-friendly lifestyle actions to earn bonus Green Points.
challenges.resetNotice: Challenges reset every Sunday at midnight.
challenges.ch_transit_desc: Take the bus, metro, or shared transit for at least 2 commute days instead of driving a personal vehicle.
challenges.ch_bag_desc: Refuse single-use plastic carrier bags for all retail and grocery trips throughout the entire week.
challenges.ch_unplug_desc: Unplug standby electronic appliances, chargers, and television setups when not actively in use.
challenges.ch_plant_desc: Inspect 3 indoor or garden plants for pests, root-rot, or chlorosis and apply organic remedies.
challenges.ch_civic_desc: Photograph and log a street hazard (pothole, water leak, or open garbage) to notify municipal authorities.
